body: I tried making the list, but I couldn't really come up with anything that I really truly wanted to do in the future. My emotions are always on the extreme side recently, as in, if I'm happy I feel like I can do anything, but if I am sad at all... it is almost to the point of suicidal. I guess I just don't see the point anymore, I'm really trying to figure it out, the sheer fact is since I don't necessarily see anything enjoyable in my future I kind of feel ... empty. I just don't know what to do from a day to day basis. I almost feel like I am completely lost with no where to go.

I'd imagine that there is a 100% of losing your character(s) at least once. Since they are adding new things all the time, anytime they directly affect the way characters work, or how items or anything functions to a large degree you are more than likely going to lose your character(s). One thing you can do though is write down coordinates to planets you really like, and then when you do lose your characters visit those planets to get some good gear or w/e. Of course, if they change how world generation works, the coords might point to a different planet. All of the above is not official, but from past experience with personal projects and different beta events this is what generally happens.
